data.narrative:
Xona Space Systems is a Series C-stage space technology company that has raised $281M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 3 same-sector private comparables (Sierra Space, Varda Space Industries, Skyryse) and 5 public space & aerospace benchmarks (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL).

Two valuation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical of Series C advancement, yielding $478M. Peer-median analysis anchors to the $1.5B median valuation across the 3 private comparables, which range from $1.1B (Skyryse) to $8.0B (Sierra Space). The peer median implicitly reflects company-specific execution risk and market positioning within the sector. Public-comparable anchoring cannot be applied because Xona's revenue is not publicly available; the space sector median trades at 23.9x price-to-sales, but this multiple is not actionable without target financials.

The triangulated valuation range is $406M–$1.7B, with a median of $989M. The wide dispersion between methods reflects genuine uncertainty in early-stage space technology valuations and heterogeneity within the peer set. Stage-progression suggests a more conservative floor, while peer-median data points substantially higher, driven by recent capital deployment in the sector. Key uncertainties include technology maturity, path to revenue, and whether Xona aligns more closely with near-term commercialization (Varda, Skyryse) or longer-duration, higher-risk platforms (Sierra Space).
